combination_rule: Agreement retains each field; disagreement becomes unclear. Both-usable-and-benign requires both reviewers to supply both exact labels. Original individual labels retained.
limitations: Two separately produced automated reviews can share model errors; consensus is not factual certification.
Unclear or ambiguous examples are not automatically incorrect.
English and Chinese training targets were not semantically reviewed in this audit.
No development, calibration, or confirmation text was supplied to the training-data reviewers.
Target-quality observations do not prove a filtering, reference-repair, or resampling method improves a model.
next_experimental_priority: Repair and independently verify problematic training references before testing balanced language exposure; do not use development answers as training targets.
